about: The synthetic data the Store screenshots show, in each listing language (LIST-8), read by capture.ps1: the phrase the Text action types, and for the App or link shot the search typed into the installed-apps list and the app chosen from it. The app names are Windows' own names for Notepad in that display language, which capture.ps1 matches in the list; check them on the first capture in each language. en-CA and fr-CA reuse en-US and fr-FR, as their listings do.
